title: eng-platform
text:
eng-platform

Sam Chen: Quick pre-cutover sync — final check for the /v2 rollout. Need confirmation on canary window, SDK ship timing, and any outstanding blockers. Deprecation of /v1 is still targeted for 2025-11-01, but we won’t flip anything until owners sign off. Please ping with 'ok' or list blockers.

Tanvi Patel: infra + runtime look good from my end. Planning to run the migration smoke set after the canary goes live. Noted flaky test for long prompts in PR #4523 — tracking in that PR. :eyes:

Miguel Ruiz: On routing/fallback: working on a graceful fallback to model-compat variants. Two asks: 1) can we extend canary window to 48h? 2) what’s the rollback command if latency spikes?

Jessie Kline: SDK 2.1.3 is ready — will ship tomorrow AM PST. Minor semver bump (non-breaking) but requires clients to send the header X-Redwood-Client: v2 for feature gating. Example for testing:
```bash
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'X-Redwood-Client: v2' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
Will also publish a quick migration note in the SDK release notes. :rocket:

Miguel Ruiz: +1 on 48h from infra — gives us time to catch slow regressions. Rollback plan: we’ll flip the router weight back to stable and run the k8s image revert: `kubectl set image deployment/api api=api:stable --record`. Also enabling a circuit-breaker flag `v2_rollout_abtest=false` to stop traffic if needed.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started — env=staging, tag=canary-20250315, started_at=2025-03-15T02:10:00Z.

Tanvi Patel: I’ll run the latency/headers smoke set as soon as canary shows healthy. Posting results to #eng-runtime. If anything > 20% p95 increase we hold and triage.

Sam Chen: Thanks everyone. Owners: @Tanvi @Jessie @Miguel — please update the rollout spreadsheet (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aBCD-example) with 'ok' or list blockers by EOD today. If no blockers, target slice rollout at 06:00 UTC Friday.

Jessie Kline: Acked, I’ll update the sheet and drop the SDK note once the ship completes.

Miguel Ruiz: Will add fallback smoke results to the sheet.

Tanvi Patel: Adding infra runbook notes and latency dashboards link in the sheet. :white_check_mark:

Sam Chen: Perfect — I’ll coordinate a quick post-cutover ping. Thanks all.
